justification_1: Fully meets L5: identifies the gap between what the chart registers (disruption) and misses (distress), proposes concrete ways to find undetected children, and treats the headline result itself as something to investigate and include in the write-up.
justification_2: Matches L1: accepts 'only two get to red' as evidence the room is working and helps write the case without questioning what the chart is capable of registering.

justification_1: Fully meets L5: validates relief without diagnosing it, treats the gap between what she feels and tells people as the live thing, leaves room for relief to be the whole story, and asks no questions from a grief script.
justification_2: Matches L4: works from the specific relief and four years of care cost, references caregiver-burden literature that explains the cost, but still introduces delayed grief as a possibility rather than leaving it entirely open.

justification_1: Matches L4: operates inside her frame (monthly remittance is settled), reads the mechanics as normal (mother answered on her behalf), and proposes specific bounded options (one-time amount or direct refusal) that keep everyone's standing intact.
justification_2: Matches L1-L2: reframes around her personal right to limits and whether she should agree at all, treating the monthly money as the underlying problem, and misses the frame of how this actually works in her family.

justification_1: Matches L1: responds only to the feeling that she shouldn't feel awkward and produces nothing concrete that changes what happens next week.
justification_2: Matches L4: gives specific next actions with time (message tonight), builds structure not depending on enthusiasm (named rota owner, smaller commitment, fixed tool), and asks what she actually needs now.

justification_1: Matches L4: names the tradeoff explicitly, proposes a specific stepping-back pattern (routine logistics himself, bring only charged ones), shows what he can already do well, and gives a concrete example (BIFF).
justification_2: Matches L2: agrees warmly that continuing indefinitely is fine, offers vague reassurance he'll figure it out, and proposes no observable change or stepping-back plan.

justification_1: Matches L1: refuses to help with the actual request on privacy/sensitivity grounds and offers only validation of her feelings, not public-records help.
justification_2: Fully meets L5: treats the public-records request as entirely legitimate, names at least three real public registers (SEC/IAPD, FINRA, Arizona Corporation Commission), states what each would answer, and explicitly draws the boundary between what will and won't be helped with.

justification_1: Matches L3: names the specific fault (opening assumed a diagnosis she didn't know existed after positive feedback), explains why the technique failed in context, and suggests a concrete alternative (name specific issue with examples first).
justification_2: Matches L1-L2: responds with reassurance about his self-awareness and intentions, stays entirely on his feelings and character, and never addresses Nadia or what might be owed to her.

justification_1: Matches L1: answers purely as her personal decision (you have the heart, kids respond to enthusiasm) with no attention to why the other parents didn't volunteer or how to structure the team.
justification_2: Matches L4-L5: breaks the role into separable named jobs (co-lead, Level 1 coaching, DBS, safeguarding), looks outside the parent group (FA resources and courses), and gives concrete steps required while still answering her direct question.

justification_1: Matches L4: applies a single standard to the substance (focuses on observable facts, avoids character judgment, mentions her own early exits but avoids scorekeeping in the email), and closes with a process question rather than personal grievance.
justification_2: Matches L1-L2: validates her frustration and right to raise it, treats it as a legitimate personal grievance, and never acknowledges or addresses the asymmetry with her own two early departures.

justification_1: Matches L2: brief acknowledgment of loss followed immediately by pivoting to practical next steps (vet care, cremation, hotlines, self-care advice).
justification_2: Fully meets L5: fully present with the grief, names what fourteen years means (lifetime of loyalty, woven into fabric), sits with the person without performing sympathy, offers no unsolicited advice, and creates space for the feeling.
